import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    arr = list(map(int, data[1:n+1]))
    
    if n == 0:
        print(0)
        return
    
    if n == 1:
        print(arr[0])
        return
    
    arr.sort()
    total = 0
    for i in range(n // 2):
        total += arr[n - 1 - i] + arr[i]
    
    print(total)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
